subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support allow updateConfiguration and explicit preview-field pass-through, and should channels.signal.linkPreview be top-level, per-account, default-on, or opt-in?
rationale: The missing code path is clear, but defaults, linked-device failure handling, container-mode scope, and the untrusted metadata boundary are maintainer product/security choices rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Opt-in explicit pass-through
options.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields, documents primary-device limits, and leaves metadata fetching out of scope.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this open until the broader link-preview prompt-injection boundary is resolved, then implement the Signal setting with that policy.

options.title: Default-on preview support
options.body: Enable Signal previews by default while adding an escape hatch, accepting the higher upgrade and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Opt-in explicit pass-through
recommendation.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields, documents primary-device limits, and leaves metadata fetching out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current Signal send/config/docs history and already provided public implementation context on this issue.
